programme.title: She's so lovely
programme.desc: Après avoir été libéré d'une institution psychiatrique, un homme tente de se racheter aux yeux de son ex-femme des événements qui ont conduit à son incarcération.

programme.title: La maison aux esprits
programme.desc: Basé sur le roman à succès d'Isabel Allende, La Maison des esprits est une épopée romantique envoûtante couvrant trois générations de la famille Trueba.

programme.title: Septembre funeste
programme.desc: Une histoire contre le massacre de Mountain Meadows, le film est basé sur la tragédie qui s'est produite dans l'Utah en 1857. Un groupe de colons, voyageant sur des chariots, a été assassiné par les mormons indigènes. Au total, environ 140 âmes d'hommes, de femmes et d'enfants ont été enlevées.

programme.title: Une nouvelle chance (2016)
programme.desc: Un avenir de jeune chef tendait les bras à Charlie. Pourtant sa vie semble s'être suspendue, habitant avec sa mère et son beau-père et travaillant dans le cinéma de son quartier, Charlie n'a plus de motivation pour rien...

programme.title: Hollywood Sunrise
programme.desc: Les acteurs d'Hollywood dissèquent leur vie personnelle lorsque tout semble s'entrechoquer.

programme.title: The Mysteries of Pittsburgh
programme.desc: L'été déterminant d'un diplômé d'université qui croise son père gangster et explore l'amour, la sexualité et les énigmes qui entourent sa vie et sa ville.

programme.title: Run
programme.desc: S'enfuir... Il vient de tuer le Premier ministre de son pays. Pour ce faire, il a dû se comporter comme un fou, errant dans la ville. Sa vie lui revient par flashs

programme.title: Une mariée en cavale
programme.desc: Juste avant son mariage, Lisa plaque son fiancé infidèle, Max, et prend le bus direction l'aéroport pour quitter l'Afrique. Le destin veut que son ancien amoureux, Vic, venu ici elle cinq ans plus tôt, voyage dans ce même bus. Il convoie incognito le Nuage d'Anamanga, un diamant légendaire. Mais le car est attaqué et la pierre tant convoitée est dérobée. Menottés l'un à l'autre, Lisa et Vic prennent la fuite dans la jungle...

programme.title: 10th & Wolf
programme.desc: Tommy, un soldat de la Marine a des ennuis et rencontre un agent du FBI.

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: The New Captain Scarlet - Épisode 22: Situé en 2068, Captain Scarlet suit la "guerre psychologique" entre la Terre et les Mysterons, une race martienne qui possède un contrôle partiel sur la matière. Lorsqu'un malentendu pousse des astronautes humains à attaquer leur ville sur Mars, les Mysterons jurent de se venger et lancent une série de représailles contre la Terre.

programme.title: Oxygen
programme.desc: Deux gars kidnappent la femme d'un homme riche et l'enterrent dans une boîte avec 24 heures d'oxygène. La détective coriace du NYPD Maddy et d'autres obtiennent l'affaire. L'atteindront-ils à temps ?

programme.title: The New Captain Scarlet
programme.desc: The New Captain Scarlet - Épisode 23: Situé en 2068, Captain Scarlet suit la "guerre psychologique" entre la Terre et les Mysterons, une race martienne qui possède un contrôle partiel sur la matière. Lorsqu'un malentendu pousse des astronautes humains à attaquer leur ville sur Mars, les Mysterons jurent de se venger et lancent une série de représailles contre la Terre.

programme.title: Charlie Says
programme.desc: Le film traite de charles manson, et en particulier l'influence qu'il a eu sur une jeune femme de 19 ans.

programme.title: Criminals: Le Dernier Casse
programme.desc: Différentes actions menées dans la ville de Londres, à notre époque, contre le milieu violent du traffic d'armes.

programme.title: Ecole Paternelle
programme.desc: DADDY DAY CARE est une comédie hilarante sur des enfants contrôlant leur nid ! Lorsque les publicitaires Charlie (Eddie Murphy, Dr. Dolittle) et Phil (Jeff Garlin, émission TV 'Curb Your Enthusiasm') perdent leurs emplois en essayant de vendre des céréales de petit-déjeuner au goût de légumes, leurs femmes partent travailler. Mais lorsqu'ils réalisent qu'ils n'ont pas les moyens de maintenir leurs enfants à la très chic Académie Chapman dirigée par la vilaine Miss Harridan (Anjelica Huston, The Addams Family), Charlie et Phil deviennent propriétaires de 'Daddy Day Care'. Ces deux Messieurs Maman ne réalisent pas encore qu'ils viennent tout juste de commencer leurs aventures en babysitting ! L'excellent casting de DADDY DAY CARE inclut aussi Steve Zahn (Stuart Little), Regina King (Legally Blonde 2: Red, White and Blonde) et Kevin Nealon (Anger Management).

programme.title: Mi-Temps Au Mitard
programme.desc: Lorsque Paul Crewe, star du football américain, se retrouve en prison pour fraude sur les matchs, il ne veut plus rien avoir à faire avec ce sport. Mais les gardiens l'obligent à monter une équipe avec les autres détenus. D'un groupe de hors-la-loi disparate, Crewe doit faire une équipe capable d'affronter les gardiens décidés à en découdre.

programme.title: Rock The Kasbah
programme.desc: Un manager musical part en Afghanistan pour une tournée humanitaire avec son tout dernier client. Durant son trajet, il croisera la route d'une adolescente à la voix unique qu'il emmène à Kaboul, lieu d'un célèbre concours de chant télévisuel local intitulé Afghan Star.

programme.title: Easy Girl
programme.desc: Après avoir menti en prétendant avoir perdu sa virginité, une jeune lycéenne très soignée fait l'objet d'accusations comparables à celles portées à Hester Prynne dans The Scarlet Letter, roman qu'elle est en train d'étudier à l'école. Elle décide de se servir de cette rumeur pour améliorer sa situation sociale et financière.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Un petit confiseur est furieux de découvrir qu'une grande entreprise de confiserie s'installe dans les environs. Mais tout se complique lorsqu'une romance improbable naît avec sa nouvelle concurrente.

programme.title: Bloody Hell
programme.desc: Un homme au passé mystérieux fuit son pays pour échapper à son propre enfer. Malheureusement pour lui, ses ennuis ne font que débuter.

programme.title: La machine à démonter le temps
programme.desc: Préparez-vous à botter le passé avec "La machine à démonter le temps !" Les rires délirants éclatent lorsque quatre amis partagent une nuit folle à boire dans un jacuzzi de station de ski, pour se réveiller avec une gueule de bois atroce... en 1986.

programme.title: Ideal Home
programme.desc: Erasmus et Paul, un couple gay, ont une vie festive et extravagante. Mais ce quotidien va être bouleversé lorsqu'un garçon de dix ans se présente à leur porte et prétend être le petit-fils d'Erasmus. Ni Paul, ni Erasmus, ne sont prêts à abandonner leur style de vie au profit de celui de parents.

programme.title: On m'appelle King
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes traque une bande de trafiquants d'armes à travers la frontière mexicaine.

programme.title: Les Impitoyables
programme.desc: Un prêtre et son frère jumeau se relaient pour défendre une petite ville contre le gang vicieux des Clayton.

programme.title: La Charge des Cosaques
programme.desc: L'histoire de Hadji Murad, un chef tchétchène du XIXe siècle qui a mené ses guerriers dans une lutte contre les forces d'invasion du tsar russe.

programme.title: Les amours de Salomé
programme.desc: Une célèbre ballerine viennoise fuit l'Europe pendant la guerre austro-prussienne et tombe amoureuse d'un bandit américain qui ressemble à son défunt amant royal.

programme.title: Le temps du massacre
programme.desc: Un chercheur d'or et son demi-frère ivrogne doivent affronter un fermier et son fils sadique après avoir pris le contrôle de sa ferme.

programme.title: Human Contagion
programme.desc: A Londres, dans un futur proche, les industries pharmaceutiques Newgen lancent un nouveau produit : le RAK-295. Ce nouveau stimulant et accélérateur de performance légal cause pourtant des changements physiques et des allergies dramatiques aux 30,000 cobayes seule Angela Mills en sort indemne. Alors que le monde succombe à une invasion de ces nouveaux zombies, Cole, mercenaire endurci, est engagé par les industries Newgen pour retrouver Angela, détentrice de l'antidote pour empêcher la fin de l'extinction de l'homme.

programme.title: Metamorphosis
programme.desc: Trois jeunes voyagent à travers la campagne hongroise dans l'espoir d'étayer la thèse au sujet de la légendaire Comtesse Elizabeth Bathory, réputée pour s'être baignée dans le sang au XVIIème siècle. Mais ils se perdent sur le retour, jusqu'à ce qu'une étrange jeune femme leur propose de les conduire au château Bathory.

programme.title: Compulsion
programme.desc: Amy, est une chef cuisinière qui rêve d'avoir son propre show télévisé culinaire. Elle est jalouse de sa voisine de palier, Saffron, qui est quant à elle une ancienne enfant star. Les deux femmes, souffrent de troubles obsessionnels à des degrés différents, elles vont confronter leurs univers intimes dans une bataille de volontés face à leurs troubles alimentaires et sexuels.

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln Contre Les Zombies
programme.desc: Durant la guerre civile, Abraham Lincoln apprend qu'une menace pèse sur l'avenir des États-Unis. Une armée de morts-vivants sudistes erre sur la surface du continent. En passant derrière les lignes ennemies, le Président se donne pour mission de détruire les zombies...

programme.title: Dead Zone
programme.desc: Un professeur de lycée subit avec sa future femme un accident de voiture qui va bouleverser sa vie. Lorsqu'il se réveille d'un coma de cinq ans, il découvre qu'il peut prédire le sort d'une personne par un simple contact physique.

programme.title: Triassic World
programme.desc: Des scientifiques parviennent à donner la vie à des dinosaures afin de leur prendre leurs organes et de sauver des humains. Mais quand les créatures s'échappent, les scientifiques vont devoir se battre pour sauver leur vie.

programme.title: Pandemic
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche ravagé par un virus mondial, l'humanité est au bord de l'extinction alors que les infectés surpassent en nombre les non-infectés. La Dr Lauren (Rachel Nichols), une médecin déterminée, se rend à Los Angeles après la chute de New York pour diriger une équipe de secours.

programme.title: 400 Days
programme.desc: Quatre astronautes sont envoyés en mission scientifique de simulation pour tester les effets psychologiques des voyages dans l'espace. Enfermés durant 400 jours dans un simulateur , l'état mental de l'équipage se détériore lorsque qu'ils perdent toute communication avec le monde extérieur.

programme.title: Imperium
programme.desc: Un jeune agent du FBI, désireux de faire ses preuves sur le terrain, se fait passer pour un suprémaciste blanc.

programme.title: Sexy Therapy
programme.desc: Nathan, un écrivain en panne d'inspiration, décide de rendre visite à ses parents en Floride. Il y retrouve sa mère atteinte de la maladie d'Alzheimer et son père qui vient de faire une attaque.

programme.title: Charlie Says
programme.desc: La tragique histoire d'une jeune fille américaine transformée en tueuse sans pitié durant l'été 1969 influencée par Charles Manson.

programme.title: En ce moment sur Box Office Action
programme.desc: Découvrez les bandes annonces des films à l'affiche sur les chaînes Box Office

programme.title: CHAPPAQUIDDICK, Le Secret des Kennedy
programme.desc: Récit des sept jours les plus dramatiques de la vie du sénateur Ted Kennedy, impliqué dans un accident de voiture ayant causé la mort de l'ancienne directrice de campagne de Robert Kennedy.

programme.title: The Wretched
programme.desc: Un adolescent provocateur, aux prises avec le divorce imminent de ses parents, affronte une sorcière de mille ans, qui vit sous la peau et se fait passer pour la femme d'à côté.

programme.title: The Thompsons
programme.desc: En fuite, la famille de vampires la plus angoissée d'Amérique se rend en Angleterre à la recherche d'un ancien clan de vampires. Ce qu'ils trouvent à la place pourrait déchirer leur famille et les égorger à jamais.

programme.title: Dans les griffes de mon sauveur
programme.desc: Découvrez l'histoire de Laura sauvée par Bruce, un homme mystérieux... Une histoire à glacer le sang, qui remet en question les apparences.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Un rite d'initiation d'une fraternité universitaire tourne mal. Un étudiant blessé par balle et une employée de supérette kidnappée se retrouvent au foyer de la fraternité. La panique persiste.

programme.title: Jack Strong
programme.desc: L'espion polonais le plus spectaculaire de l'époque de la guerre froide, le colonel Ryszard Kuklinski, informe les Américains des plus grands secrets du bloc communiste face à l'imminence de la loi martiale.

programme.title: Terrifier 2
programme.desc: Après avoir été ressuscité par une entité sinistre, Art le Clown revient dans la ville de Miles County où il prend pour cible une adolescente et son jeune frère le soir d'Halloween.

programme.title: In Search of Darkness
programme.desc: Plongez dans l'horreur des années 80 avec cette conclusion gargantuesque qui s'attaque à l'âge d'or de la VHS et des vidéoclubs, dresse les portraits d'artistes et artisans incontournables et aborde de nombreuses pépites oubliées d'un cinéma imaginatif, sanglant, expérimental, indispensable…

programme.title: Vigilante
programme.desc: Fou de rage après l'agression de son épouse et le meurtre de son fils et écœuré par le laxisme et la corruption des autorités, qui ont permis aux responsables d'être libérés, un électricien new-yorkais s'acoquine avec un groupe d'auto-défense, dans lequel il refusait d'entrer jusqu'alors, afin de venger sa famille.

programme.title: The Belgian Wave
programme.desc: Au début des années 90, le journaliste Marc Varenberg et son caméraman disparaissent dans des circonstances mystérieuses alors qu'ils enquêtent sur la Vague Belge (une série d'observations d'Ovni survenus entre 1989 et 1991). Près de 30 ans plus tard, deux webreporters rouvrent l'enquête pour découvrir ce qui s'est réellement passé.

programme.title: In Search of Darkness
programme.desc: Plongez dans l'horreur des années 80 avec cette conclusion gargantuesque qui s'attaque à l'âge d'or de la VHS et des vidéoclubs, dresse les portraits d'artistes et artisans incontournables et aborde de nombreuses pépites oubliées d'un cinéma imaginatif, sanglant, expérimental, indispensable…

programme.title: Rabid
programme.desc: Après un accident, Rose guérit grâce à un traitement expérimental mais développe une soif de sang humain.

programme.title: The Other Side
programme.desc: Shirin s'installe avec son beau-fils Lucas, hanté par une présence maléfique dans la maison voisine.

programme.title: Dementia
programme.desc: Un vétéran atteint de démence découvre que son infirmière cache de terribles secrets.

programme.title: Origine Inconnue
programme.desc: Après un accident mortel sur Mars, Mackenzie Wilson collabore avec une intelligence artificielle et découvre un mystérieux objet.

programme.title: War Of Apes
programme.desc: Pour sauver l'humanité, un gigantesque singe et son ennemi mécanique, Mecha Ape MkII, s'allient.

programme.title: Bent
programme.desc: Lors de sa dernière enquête en date, un ancien flic devenu détective privé fait le lien entre un homicide et un complot gouvernemental impliquant des agents secrets corrompus.

programme.title: Braquage à Monte-Carlo
programme.desc: Matvey Levin, un banquier projette le cambriolage de sa propre banque, à Monte-Carlo. Mais, pour cela, il a besoin de l'aide de ses enfants...

programme.title: Dahmer
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vrai, Dahmer raconte l'histoire du serial-killer Jeffrey Dahmer.

programme.title: La vengeance sous la peau
programme.desc: Arrivé en Chine pour donner un de ses reins à sa nièce mourante, Deacon se réveille la veille de l'opération et découvre qu'il est victime d'un réseau de trafic d'organes...

programme.title: Sexcrimes 2
programme.desc: Rester proche de ses amis et encore plus proche de ses ennemis n'a jamais été plus important… ou plus dangereux. Les filles de Blue Bay sont de retour, plus farouches que jamais dans cette suite sexy du thriller érotique Wild Things où personne n'est innocent et rien n'est ce qu'il semble être.

programme.title: Sexcrimes : Diamants Mortels
programme.desc: Marie se retrouve mêlée à une machination après sa rencontre avec Elena, la nouvelle de l'école. Elle taquine Marie à cause de sa fortune et flirte avec Jay, son beau-père. Quand elle l'accuse de viol pour lui extorquer de l'argent, elle pique la curiosité de Kristen, qui fait campagne à l'école contre le viol.

programme.title: Mary Shelley's Frankenstein
programme.desc: Le film culte de KENNEGHT BRANAGH avec ROBERT DE NIRO et HELENA BONHAM CARTER. Le jeune savant Victor Frankenstein est persuadé que la science peut venir à bout de tout et même créer la vie. Il s'attèle à cette tâche avec ardeur et crée à partir de morceaux de cadavres un être humain qui sera acculé par sa différence à la méchanceté. Prenant conscience du monstre qu'il a créé, celui-ci va bientôt lui échappée…

programme.title: Glory
programme.desc: 1863 - La Guerre de Sécession ravage les États-Unis. Le jeune Robert Gould Shaw est promu colonel du premier régiment de soldats noirs, engagés volontaires dans une guerre qu'ils croient être la leur. Ils se trompent. Assignés à des tâches subalternes, méprisés par leurs officiers, ils se révoltent, avec Shaw à leur tête. Volontaires pour partir à l'assaut de l'imprenable Fort Wagner, ces héros paieront le prix fort pour retrouver leurs dignités.

programme.title: Takers
programme.desc: TAKERS raconte l'histoire d'un célèbre groupe de braqueurs qui continuent à désarçonner la police en commettant des braquages de banques parfaits. Tout marche comme sur des roulettes : ils ne laissent jamais aucune preuve derrière eux et font profil bas entre chaque hold-up.

programme.title: Fight Club

programme.title: Young Adam

Tracking these majestic birds reveals the wild nature of their hunting grounds, showcasing the diverse animal and plant life that share their habitat with the 'king of the skies.' Viewers are brought up close as the eagle effortlessly glides over forests and canyons, abruptly diving in a breathtaking pursuit of prey. programme.title: Rewilding: Back to Nature
programme.desc: Worldwide, there are various projects and approaches to give nature more space again. The aim is to create larger wilderness areas that develop with hardly any influence of humans - by reintroducing so-called key animal species and creating a network of wilderness corridors across entire continents. Rewilding promises to be a cost-effective form of conservation in which we can boost biodiversity and protect the climate.

programme.title: Dust And Stripes
programme.desc: In a never-ending quest for grass and water, the striped herds undertake an annual epic trek across the vast lunar landscape of the Kalahari's Makgadikgadi Pans. Most of the year, the Makgadikgadi is an inhospitable wasteland of windswept, salt-encrusted pans. For the area's water-dependent zebra, the Boteti River on the western edge of the pans is a dry-season lifeline. However, it is also a death trap, with lions waiting in ambush and crocodiles lurking in dark riverside caves.

programme.title: Missing Butterflies

However, in the last few years, many have observed a decrease in the butterfly population. A much-discussed topic in the entomological society is the decline of the insect populace, but to what extent is this topic relevant to our beloved butterflies? For years, a teacher from lower Bavaria and a biologist from Munich have dedicated themselves to studying the butterfly and their presence in Bavaria. The results of their studies tell an enlightening story that is sure to entertain.

programme.title: Children of the Sun

programme.title: Children of the Sun

Few realize that there are over 560 different species of bees - most of them live their lives “busy as a bee“ but some “abuse“ other insects and others are even known to be murderers. The film “Wild Bees” shows the incredible diversity and the stunning adaptations of our “BEES” to various habitats and diverse living conditions. Fascinating fights, sensational performances, imposing structures and colorful individuals – the world of “Wild Bees” offers all of this and more.

programme.title: Hummingbirds: Jewelled Messengers

Their wings beat 50 times a second. They can hover on the spot, and even fly backwards. To our eyes, they are just a blur. But with the aid of high-speed cameras we can slow down their hyperactive lives and look into their secret world.

programme.title: Dolphin Cruise
programme.desc: Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a science contest at school and win a trip on a luxury yacht but not everything goes as planned when they set out to sea. When Olivia, Stephanie, Andrea, Mia and Emma enter a school science contest and win a Dolphin sight-seeing trip, not everything goes to plan...As the girls set out to sea on a luxury yacht, misunderstandings and disagreements occur which become secondary when they discover a pod of dolphins in danger. The girls learn that they have to compromise and trust in each other if they are to save the dolphins and their trip out to sea...

programme.title: Rise Of The Snakes
programme.desc: The four Ninja are snapped out of their post-hero complacency when Lord Garmadon's young son Lloyd shows up and tries to pick up where his father left off. The Ninja dismiss him as a threat, but regret that choice after Lloyd wakes up the evil snake tribe. A prophecy is revealed that states a green ninja will ultimately defeat Lord Garmadon.

programme.title: Home
programme.desc: Back in training mode with the looming threat of Lloyd and the Hypnobrai, Zane wanders after a Falcon and lands himself in a heap of trouble. The rest of the Ninja leave the training dojo to help him and return to find that the snakes have burned it to the ground.

programme.title: Snakebit
programme.desc: Lloyd, having been kicked out of the Hynobrai snake tribe unlocks a second tribe – The Fangpyres – to help him regain control. The Ninja are busy setting up their new HQ that Zane discovered, but are called to duty when the Fangpyres attack the village where Jay's family lives.

programme.title: Never Trust A Snake
programme.desc: After the Fangpyres join forces with the Hypnobrai, Lloyd awakens Pythor – the last remaining snake of the Anacondrai tribe. Pythor lures Lloyd under his spell and steals a map from him that will show him where the remaining two snakes tribes dwell and Uncle Sensei saves Lloyd from doom.

programme.title: Country Girls
programme.desc: When the girls go to Mia's grandparents' ranch and Olivia accidentally knocks down the neighbor's barn, the girls promise to raise money to rebuild it and now have to learn to set aside their differences and work together to make good on their promise. Mia invites her friends to her grandparents' ranch for the weekend. But when Olivia accidentally knocks down a neighbor's barn with a tractor, the girls promise to raise the money to rebuild it themselves. Complicating matters, Mia and Stephanie turn out to like the same boy, Martin. They'll have to learn to set aside their differences and work together if they're going to raise enough money to make good on their promise.

programme.title: Emma's Dilemma
programme.desc: When Stephanie becomes obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in a float building contest and accidentally disregards Emma's ideas and design, Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to get revenge on Stephanie. When the girls enter a float-building contest, Emma is especially excited to share her design idea for the float. But no one is listening to her, especially Stephanie, who's become obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in the contest. Emma finally does find someone who appreciates her design… Tanya! Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to build the float design. But is Tanya just using Emma to get revenge on Stephanie?

programme.title: Friends of The Jungle
programme.desc: When Olivia's Aunt Sophie is getting married and the groom has gone missing in the jungle, the girls fly out to the jungle in secret to try to find him in time for the wedding. The girls are super excited to be planning a wedding for Olivia's Aunt Sophie. There's just one little problem: Olivia learns that the groom has gone missing in the jungle while working at an animal rescue station! Not wanting to worry her aunt, Olivia, Stephanie and Mia secretly fly to the jungle to try and find the groom, Henry, rescuing a few animals along the way. Too bad Emma and Andrea couldn't keep the secret back in Heartlake City. Now, Sophie, Emma and Andrea join the others in the jungle to try and find Henry before the rapidly approaching wedding date!

programme.title: Can Of Worms
programme.desc: Lloyd moves in and tries to make nice by helping out with chores, but he just gets in the way. Pythor has awoken the Vipoids and the Constrictaurs and an all out snake war has taken over Ninjago. The Ninja are not faring well, when a mysterious Samurai shows up and saves the day.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: He Who Smurfs Last
programme.desc: Jokey's practical jokes go too far when Chlorhydris is the victim of one. She gets her revenge on the Smurfs by creating a spell to steal their sense of humor. Grouchy, who had no sense of humor to begin with, breaks the spell by getting back the humor potion.

programme.title: Jokey's Medecine
programme.desc: Because of Jokey's pranks, none of the Smurfs believe him when he tells them that Azrael the cat is ready to pounce on them. Feeling guilty and responsible, he hurries to Gargamel's castle and plays some explosive jokes on the wizard and his cat so he can free his friends.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Royal Drum: No one believes Grandpa Smurf when he tells of far-away jungles and savannahs teeming with wild giant cats, striped horses, long-necked leaf-eaters and strange tribes... Only some Smurflings give some credit to his tales. But when Grandpa Smurf hears the sound of the magic Royal Drum in the forest, the one that can tame wild beasts, he sets out to prove that he's not an old addle-brained storyteller.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Kow-Tow, We Won't Bow: Smurfette leads the Smurflings on a nature hike, but Puppy gets too far ahead and they chase him into the land of the Wartmongers. King Bullrush captures them in bubbles and imprisons them. A group of rebels rescue the Smurflings and they escape on the back of Puppy.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf On The Wild Side, Part I: What, or who, is that strange being in the forest? It looks vaguely like a Smurf, but it chatters away like the squirrel that seems to be accompanying it… And why is Papa Smurf talking about the Lost Smurfling?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Snappy's Puppet: Snappy has a new trick: he frightens everybody, or tries to, with his hand-puppet dragon. But it gets, shall we say, out of hand when Papa Smurf's magic liquid falls on the puppet and it comes alive. Alive and kicking, what's more, endangering Snappy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - No Smurf Is An Island: Handy Smurf is the one who fixes everything that needs mending in the Village of the Smurfs. But are his efforts really appreciated by the other Smurfs? Not at all. At least this is what Handy feels when he resolves to leave the Smurfs Village forever and live in the sea with Marina the Mermaid...

programme.title: Farmer's Genie
programme.desc: As Farmer Smurf says, what's a gourd doing in the melon patch, when it should be by the rutabagas? But when Farmer Smurf pulls the gourd out of the ground he frees a genie, which calls him Master and insists on granting him wishes. The genie, called Gourdy, is going to be more of a hindrance than a help in his eagerness to please Farmer Smurf.

programme.title: Poet's Writers' Block
programme.desc: The Smurfs want a poem written for each of them. The pressure overwhelms Poet, so he runs away seeking inspiration. The Wilybeast King captures Poet and forces him to write a poem to cheer up the King's daughter. Poet learns that motivation must come from the heart and cannot be forced.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Crooner Smurf: Harmony Smurf is no longer wanted in the Smurf Choir: his singing is too far off-key. But Papa Smurf gives him an amulet that will make him a vocal virtuoso. Now here comes Hogatha...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Baby Smurf Is Missing: Thinking Baby Smurf is a leprechaun, two poachers kidnap him and try to get the small one to tell them where his pot of gold is hidden. Papa Smurf organizes everyone to attack the villains with Smurfberry pies so Baby can escape.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Smurfing Out Of Time: None of the Smurfs seem to have time to play with the Smurflings. They go on a visit to Father Time and come across the River of Time, the great current that flows along majestically, carrying with it all the time in the world. And then an accident occurs, with untimely consequences...

programme.title: Tailor's Magic Needle
programme.desc: Tailor Smurf has to make an outfit for every Smurf before the Fall fashion show. Brainy Smurf wants to help him and, using Papa Smurf's book of Magic, he conjures up a magic needle that sews ten times faster than tailor... But is it really any good?

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Memory Melon: Selwyn and Tallulah are two powerful married wizards. The trouble is, they fight all the time. But the energy from their arguments is brewing up a dreadful storm and Papa has to get them to make up before the storm starts to rage.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - A Smurf For Denisa: Balthazar brings Denisa to Gargamel to baby-sit. But Gargamel loses Denisa in the wood and she and Sassette meet and become friends. Sassette and Denisa work together to free the Smurfs from Gargamel's stewpot, and prove you don't have to be big to be brave.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Peewit's Unscrupulous Adventure: Peewit, the court jester, is the Smurfs' human friend. There is to be a celebration at the King's castle and Peewit good-humouredly invites his little blue friends to the feast. But they learn that the wicked chamberlain is pilfering the King's possessions.

programme.title: The Smurfiest Of Friends
programme.desc: Brainy Smurf had one friend: Clumsy Smurf. But poor Clumsy is so, well, clumsy, that Brainy refuses to see him again. So now he is left without anyone willing to listen to him. Maybe Buddy, the good-looking imp met by chance near the Great Oak can be a pal for Brainy....

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Poltersmurf: There are few things Grandpa Smurf enjoys more than telling a good scary story, and there are few Smurfs who don't love to listen. But things get a little too much for Brainy Smurf when Grandpa tells of Poltersmurfs, and Poltersmurfs begin harrowing Brainy...

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - Greedy And The Porridge Pot: The good fairy, Guinilda gives Greedy a magic porridge pot that Brainy causes to overflow into the village and forest. The good-hearted fairy hurries to the rescue and then asks for the pot back to give to an orphanage of hungry children.

programme.title: The Smurfs
programme.desc: The Smurfs - The Most Unsmurfy Games: To prove the worth of his Big Book of Wilderness Survival, Brainy takes the Smurflings to the swamp. Where, thanks to his expert advice, the tiny group gets totally lost, is then caught in quicklime and trapped by King Bullrush of the Wartmongers. Fortunately, Bullrush is in a playful mood and devises a Smurf hunt. Unfortunately, Brainy believes he is a born leader...

programme.title: The Rabbids are lost
programme.desc: A rabbid who got talent after having inhaled the air from a balloon, is suddenly destined to become a star!

programme.title: Dr Mad Rabbid is out of control!
programme.desc: Mad Rabbid has found a great way to become invisible, now he just needs a guinea pig to test it.

programme.title: The Rabbids are back!
programme.desc: Things don't go according to plan when the Rabbids start following a hitchhiker.

programme.title: Twinkle, twinkle, little star
programme.desc: Do you think it's hard to get a star from the sky? Nothing is impossible for our heroes! Just build a space ship and take a couple of faithful friends with you, and unforgettable adventures awaits! Bear, Masha and Panda not only visited the moon, but also brought a gift for Lady Bear. Which one? Of course, cosmic!

programme.title: A Ghost Story
programme.desc: At first time in her life Masha is frightened in earnest, however this creepy story shook up the whole forest and now hardly anyone can stay away from these strange scenes! And what would you do if your own pillow and blanket turn into real ghosts?! A real ghost story, oh yeah!

programme.title: Little Cousin
programme.desc: The Bear's little cousin, Panda, comes over to pay a visit. Masha immediately wants to pal up and spend time playing games. A competitive spirit arouses in our heroes as they can't share anything between each other. The Bear quickly figures out that if he leads their rivalry in peaceful direction, they could greatly help him around the house.

programme.title: Love is in the Bear
programme.desc: Ah, love, love! Bear prepares a gift for the Lady Bear and, as usual, dreams of winning his lady's heart. But Masha is also here! To what else, besides a total mess, will her interference in the affairs of the heart lead to?

programme.title: We Come In Peace!
programme.desc: In the courtyard of the Bear's house a spaceship makes an emergency landing. The aliens need to urgently replenish their supplies and return home. Only on the ground everything is arranged differently than at home. Masha and Mishka will help them to understand what's what, fix the ship and go back to home.

programme.title: Creepy Tale About Useful Inventions
programme.desc: Here is another spooky story about useful inventions that might nonetheless ruin your life…just imagine…what if there is mega brain who wants to conquer the Earth with some mechanical monsters?! You might think it's a joke, but there are so many gadgets around you, can you guarantee that you are safe? Ok, ok, relax, Masha will find a way out! Oh, yeah!

programme.title: Grim Tale About One Girl Who Was Afraid Of Animals
programme.desc: The tree, by the way, can be an excellent option – even if you still don't know how to climb the branches! The sense of fear will be your best motivation! At least some our heroes have acquired this skill very fast. But you, my honey-bunny, don't have to worry: most of these fears end up when you reach the top of the tree or when some adult comes for help. So please, don't be afraid and enjoy our new episode – you'll like it for sure!What if all kinds of animal scare you to death? Imagine one little girl who was sooooo afraid of animals that was ready to climb the tree in order to escape from such a horrific meeting.

programme.title: Terrible Legend About Thunder And Lightning
programme.desc: Masha tells an existing story about thunder and lighting and what might happen if the lighting suddenly catches you in the park…while you are enjoying your orange lemonade?

programme.title: Tales from the East
programme.desc: Every person dreams all his desires are fulfilled. But what does the Bear dream about? Look how his life transforms when a magic genie appears in it...

programme.title: That's your cue!
programme.desc: An old friend comes to visit the Bear. He brings along an amazing game - billiards. Isn't it an excuse to have fun and compete? However, it's not so easy when Masha enters the game. She's no only capable of confusing everything, but she can turn all upside down. Who will be the best player in this exciting competition? Look for the answer in the new episode!

programme.title: Springtime For Bear
programme.desc: The Bear wakes up with the arrival of spring. While running around the forest, he stumbles upon a beautiful female bear. He quickly falls in love. He grabs some flowers and chocolates and rushes to her hoping to invite her for a date. Of course, Masha ruins all of his plans. The Bear does his best to get rid of the girl disturbs their idyll. Finally the female Bear notices her and demands an explanation. He tries to explain but faces with a choice –Masha or the female Bear. The Bear can't make up his mind at once and the Female Bear goes away with another bear.

programme.title: Something Yummy
programme.desc: Everyone has their own favorite food. Our friends are ready to enjoy something delicious in the new episode. Can a treat be tasty and healthy at the same time?Masha is looking for her answer to this simple question and once again she is convinced that there is nothing better than porridge! Want to find your answer? Watch this episode and see for yourself!

programme.title: Little Cousin
programme.desc: The Bear's little cousin, Panda, comes over to pay a visit. Masha immediately wants to pal up and spend time playing games. A competitive spirit arouses in our heroes as they can't share anything between each other. The Bear quickly figures out that if he leads their rivalry in peaceful direction, they could greatly help him around the house.

programme.title: Who's Gifted?
programme.desc: Christmas is a time of miracles and gifts. All the inhabitants of the forest prepared performances for Santa Claus, but Masha was the best prepared. Does the good wizard have enough gifts for her?

programme.title: Hide and seek is not for the Weak
programme.desc: Masha wants to play hide and seek. But the Bear has other plans in mind. Knowing that it is impos-sible to go against her wishes, he agrees to play with her. Like many little children Masha “hides” by simply covering her eyes with her hands and the Bear decides to hide himself. He chooses the most incredible places. But nevertheless Masha finds him every time and demands to play with her and once again hides by covering up her eyes.

programme.title: Tour de Forest
programme.desc: Himalayan Bear is once again competing with Bear! This time they have arranged a bike race, but something doesn't smell right: Himalayan Bear intends on cheating to win! Good thing Masha stands as a guardian of justice and always comes to a friend's aid!

programme.title: Hat Trick
programme.desc: The Bear is desperately struggling against the greedy moth, which appeared in his house. Trying to save his magic box, he puts it on the porch, and Masha finds the magic hat that can make her invisible ...

programme.title: Think Outside the Box
programme.desc: Masha and Penguin go to Mars and from there they go straight to the open sea to the Frog Princess, and new adventures are already waiting for friends overboard. How did all this appear at Bear's house?

programme.title: Call Me Please!
programme.desc: A funny interpretation of an old fable about a boy who called for help and shouted “Wolves!”. The Bear wants to watch a soccer game but first he needs to get rid of the girl. The Bear sends her foe a walk to the forest and gave her a cell phone in order to be safe. As a result Masha annoys him with her calls for any trivial reasons and when she finds herself in real danger, the Bear doesn't answer the phone …

programme.title: Driving Lessons
programme.desc: Who wants to pimp a car? Then hurry up to stand in a queue! Why? Because in a new, 55th episode there are loads of unexpected things that happened in the forest: Masha appears as a first-rate mechanic , wolves who, obviously, decided to change their occupation appear as taxi drivers ... okay, okay… we should stop throwing spoilers around…watch everything yourself!

programme.title: Stripes And Whiskers
programme.desc: The Circus Tiger visits his old friend Bear. The whiskered and stripped cat is utterly bewildered by Masha's behavior and tries everything to get rid of her. Nevertheless his changes his mind when he gets lost in the forest and Masha saves in the middle of the night.

programme.title: Red Riding Hood
programme.desc: Mom asked Red Riding Hood to carry some cakes to her grandmother. The cakes smelled so delicious that the girl decided to sit on a stump to eat a pie. Suddenly the Roly-Poly bun sat next to her, so that she decided to take him with her to the grandmother. At the same time the Wolf, who was nearby, overheard the Red Riding Hood, rushed to the grandmother's house, ate her and started to wait for the girl to arrive. When she appeared on the doorstep the Wolf ate her together with the Roly-Poly, but his stomach began to ache, so that he exploded. The Roly-Poly rolled on, but he was unlucky to have met the Fox, who ate him. From this story Masha concludes that it is very important to visit your grandmother more often and be more prudent!

programme.title: The Magic Swan Geese
programme.desc: The story tells how important it is to listen to the elders. Alyonushka and her brother Ivanushka went to the forest disobeying the parents. The children met the magical stove and the talking apple tree. The stove fed the children some cakes. Ivanushka was thirsty and Alyonushka went to the milk river with jelly shores to quench her brother's thirst. But Ivanushka did not wait for his sister to come back and drank from the puddle. Suddenly he turned into a little goat. The flying flock of swan geese kidnapped Ivanushka, but he managed to escape. Than Ivanushka found his sister and they got out of the forest. Ivanushka has had a long healing process before he could return back to his human look again.

programme.title: The Swineherd
programme.desc: Masha tells the fairy tale called «The Swineherd" with the unexpected moral: even the most expensive things will not make the human out of a pig. The story tells about a naughty Princess who was so fond of unusual toys that she actually preferred them to any living creature. The Prince decided to teach the Princess a lesson - he turned into a swineherd and sold his magic pot to the Princess. It was not a usual, pot but it could cook so much porridge that no one can imagine! The Princess was so excited to get a new toy that she did not even ask the swineherd for a magic spell for a pot to stop cooking the porridge. Thus she had to apologize to the Prince and start being more discerning.

programme.title: The Snow Maiden
programme.desc: Masha tells the Russian fairy tale about the Snow Maiden which was molded by Grandmother and Grandfather. The Snow Maiden grew very fast. Grandmother and Grandfather cared much about her and did not let her out of the house to prevent her melting. When the summer had come they placed her into the fridge. Once the grandparents left the house and the Snow Maiden went outside to shoot the fireworks with other children and jump over the fire. Then she jumped straight into the fire and melted right away. The moral of the story is that the children should not play with fire and fireworks to be safe.

programme.title: The Frog Princess
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Fluffy Dessert
programme.desc: The clouds are so airy, so similar to different sweets and, probably, very tasty! Masha and the Bear decide to take to the skies and try the airy dessert, but the Wolves interfere with their plans.

programme.title: When a Pig Flies
programme.desc: Rosie has lost her peace because of such appetizing and ripe acorns growing right above her little snout. To get the desired but inaccessible delicacy, she must jump above her head or simply learn how to fly. It's good there is Masha around, who knows for sure it is always useful to dream.

programme.title: Sabre-Toothed Bear
programme.desc: Everyone is curious to know more details about their ancestors: what they were like, what did they do… Once upon a time the Bear took an interest in how his progenitor Bear could look like. In order to answer this question the Bear has to invent and build…guess what? - a real time machine! And, of course, Masha could not miss such a discovery!

programme.title: When Life Gives You Lemons
programme.desc: The Bear has a plan to save the sweltering She-Bear> He's planned a date and made refreshing homemade lemonade from his own grown lemons. But as usual, Masha bursts into the plan. Treat the whole forest with lemonade - that's the best idea! Quiet date - that's not great! Hello lemonade fever!

programme.title: Victory Cry
programme.desc: Hoping to charm the female Bear who was fond of playing tennis the Bear builds a tennis court in the yard. The Himalayan bear wants to show off before the female bear and ruins the plan. Masha decides to save the situation and calls the Himalayan bear for a tournament. Masha tries to grasp the playing technique but soon realizes that the victory secret lies in something else…

programme.title: Monkey business
programme.desc: No child likes to live by the rules: clean up after themselves, learn, do homework in time... It's much more interesting to go on a fun adventure with new friends. But how will such a tempting journey end? In this new episode, Masha decides to quit her previous life and... disappears! Will the Bear find her? Watch to find out!

programme.title: Home Improvement
programme.desc: The Bear's idea to hang a new picture frame on the wall ends up with huge explosion. The Bear has to start a great repair. Masha and the other animals help Bear with this difficult job.

programme.title: Treasure Island
programme.desc: When you're with your best friends, adventure is right around the corner! This time Masha and her faithful companions go on an amazing journey for pirate treasures. What awaits the brave travelers on the road ahead?

programme.title: Soup Pursuit
programme.desc: The wolves are going to cook borscht under Masha's guidance. They have a cookbook, a big pot and a ravenous appetite. But they still gotta get the ingredients! It seems that the newly-minted culinary specialists will get something interesting going on.

programme.title: Finders Keepers
programme.desc: What a great find in the forest! Masha has come across a real live hat! Is it worth saying how delighted the little mischievous girl is from all the wonders that are happening around her? But every thing has a master - and the hat, as it turns out, is no exception.

programme.title: Christmas Carol
programme.desc: It's always important to remember who your friends are. Masha is almost ready for Christmas and the gifts, when ghosts of the past visit her. Masha has to answer a difficult question: how to keep old friends in chase of Christmas desires?

programme.title: How to Train Your Plant
programme.desc: She-Bear is going to a resort and leaves Bear with her “pet” – a flycatcher. The modest flower suddenly shows an excellent appetite. Masha, of course, knows better than anyone how to treat the flycatcher. She-Bear will be surprised when she returns to the forest and sees what came out of such a “feeding”!

programme.title: Awesome Blossoms
programme.desc: Bear has a new problem: his garden has been overtaken by dandelions! As Bear tries to fight against the weeds, Masha does not understand why he is picking flowers just to throw them away. After all, dandelions can be so beautiful!

programme.title: Growing Potion
programme.desc: While inspecting his garden, the Bear notices that his tulips are not doing well. At that moment, he sees his rival, the Himalayan bear, walking by with the Female Bear. The Bear is fed up with mockery and decides to make the ultimate growing potion. He latches himself in his closet that he has transformed into a chemical lab. But then Masha appears and does her best to get the growing potion.

programme.title: And Action!
programme.desc: Masha and the Bear decide to shoot a movie, but they are arguing about the plot. So what will be the movie about? About spies, monsters or the distant worlds? Or maybe there is a more interesting idea?

programme.title: Something Yummy
programme.desc: Everyone has their own favorite food. Our friends are ready to enjoy something delicious in the new episode. Can a treat be tasty and healthy at the same time?Masha is looking for her answer to this simple question and once again she is convinced that there is nothing better than porridge! Want to find your answer? Watch this episode and see for yourself!

programme.title: The First Swallow
programme.desc: Do you know what ornithology is? This is a science that studies birds! Andit is also Dasha's new hobby. She comes to visit Masha and the Bear and discovers a new unique bird species! What is this amazing unusual bird? Hurry up and watch this new episode to find out!

programme.title: Sinister Saga Of A Sick Tummy And A Girl Who Was Afraid Of Doctors
programme.desc: Masha narrates a terrific story about one little girl who was afraid of doctors. And once upon a time she experienced one fantastic story…she decided to cook dinner for her dolls. She took some clay and made “meat balls” with “semolina porridge”. As the meal seemed tasty, Sima decided to eat a bit of her dinner too… And so she lies in her bad and feels a horrible stomachache. Nobody knows how long she would need to suffer, but when she woke up…she realized herself in hospital…near the real snow queen… who explained that medical treatment is not scary at all…though some other things are very fearsome! Oh yeah!

programme.title: Soul Freezing Tale Of Grim Forest And Tiny Timid Bug
programme.desc: All children are afraid of the dark. Masha was afraid of it too and had to sit with a torch all night long! But once upon a time she came up with the tale about a tiny bug, which lived in the woods and was so afraid of the dark, that every rustle made its heart tremble! The bug suffered a lot until he realized that all tiny things you see in the dark just seem to be frightful and fear makes no sense at all!

programme.title: Scary Story About Spooky Stories
programme.desc: Are you sure that you really like spooky stories? What if this kind of story will get you really thrilled? Listen to one classic story and don't say that you are not shocked after all!

programme.title: Super Scary Story Of A Little Boy Who Was Afraid Of Washing
programme.desc: One boy was so afraid of the water that he stopped washing himself and turned into a piggy! All his buddies ran away from him scared! But in the end he overcame his fear and began to wash his face and hands as he realized that the water can be safe and fun! The boy was very brave and even won a swimming competition!

programme.title: Gloomy Story About The Darkest Dreams
programme.desc: All children are keen on computer games! Everyone likes to shoot a couple of monsters before going to sleep. Tolik also liked to play shooters until the monsters attack him in reality in order to commit the revenge! Or…was it just a dream? Let's see...

programme.title: Sonic Underground
programme.desc: On a trip to Port Mobius, Sonic, Manic and Sonia are told that ships are sinking due to the Mobian sea-beast.

programme.sub-title: Who Do You Think You Are

programme.title: Sonic Underground

programme.title: Sonic Underground

programme.title: Sweet Revenge
programme.desc: This web drama is a teen fantasy drama about a teenager who gets her hands on a note that enacts revenge on anyone whose name is written on it.

programme.title: WTwo Worlds Apart
programme.desc: A love story between a couple in their early thirties. They belong to the same era but alternate realities. A surgical resident is pulled into the webtoon world of W, which was created by her father, and becomes entangled in a murder mystery.

programme.title: One More Happy Ending
programme.desc: Former members of a girl band pursue romance with various suitors while coming to terms with their waning celebrity statuses and ever-evolving relationships with one another.

programme.title: 365 Reat the Year
programme.desc: A story where ten people get the chance to go back in time by one year, but unexpectedly mysterious situations start to arise when their fates are changed and twisted in the process past.

programme.title: Gaus Electronics
programme.desc: Stress is no stranger to the members of Marketing Team 3 of the home appliance department at the Gaus Electronics HQ. The firm is a busy, multinational company, but this is a team that most workers dream of getting out of – and where chaos is no stranger!

programme.title: Less than Evil
programme.desc: It is a crime drama about the psychological games between a detective with a strong sense of justice but tormented by the crimes he solves, and a genius woman who is insensitive to her own death. ~~ A remake of the UK series "Luther".

programme.title: Kairos
programme.desc: On the day of Yuil Constuction's charity concert, the daughter of Seo-jin, the company's youngest director, goes missing. Seo-jin tries to find his daughter, but even the police aren't making much progress.

programme.title: You Are My Destiny
programme.desc: A touching Korean drama filled with comedy about a girl who finds happiness, friendship and love in the most unexpected way!

programme.title: Flower Of Evil
programme.desc: Baek Hee Sung changes his identity and hides his past from his detective wife, until she discovers he has secrets while investigating a series of unexplained murders

programme.title: Summer Strike
programme.desc: Lee Yeo Reum is a young woman whose career and life are going very well: She has just been awarded permanent contract status at work, and she has a boyfriend she likes very much. But work is starting to get stressful, and then she is hit with a double whammy of misfortune.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Har Har Bhakti
programme.desc: Listen to Har Har Bhakti Devotional songs and start your day with praise of gods and goddesses. These songs are composed to inspire reverence, devotion, and connection with the divine.

programme.title: Maata Ki Mahima
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Yam Kisi Se Kam Nahin
programme.desc: A misfit, a God, a husband, and a breadwinner, Yamraj is a common man with a fancy job title. He tries his best to give his family what they need and manages to make a mess of everything in the bargain. Lovable and goofy, this God of Death is anything but grim. Join our hardworking but hen-pecked Yamraj, his beloved buffalo and his motely family and friends in a slice-of-life sitcom to find out how the cookie really crumbles!

programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Laal Banarasi
programme.desc: The story highlights the exploitation happening with the ‘Bunkars' in Banaras, whose craft is appreciated all around the world, but they are paid peanuts by the traders. Amidst this, blooms a love story between the two opposites - Gauri, a bunkar and Garv, a trader. The story is of Gauri who belongs to the bunkar community facing series of incidents which destroys her family and swears to bring about a change in their life and stop the exploitation by directly trading the sarees. This becomes a battle with traders creating hurdles in her life but she is unstoppable.

programme.title: Janani
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: Do Chutki Sindoor
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: Dahej Daasi
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

In order to find her mother, Zachary stepped on the magic subway without hesitation! When the train arrived at the station, Zachary found that he had come to a magical world of elves. He also met the elf Rooney chased by hunters. In order to protect the Rooney, they fled to the underground city. Here, Zachary meets Scarlett, a red haired girl, and Zachary accidently becomes the Rooney and is regarded as a half-face hunter who is under searched with big bonus in the underground city. In order to leave the underground city to find his mother, Zachary has to agree to fight with the old wizard, the King of the underground city. Under Scarlett's training, Zachary grew up fast. In the battle, his determination to protect the Rooney inspired the strength in the necklace and defeated the old wizard. And just when the angry wizard decided to show his real strength, the real half hunter came to the rescue. The real half hunter even had the same necklace. The unexpected encounter of the two necklaces triggered the emergence of spirits and demons which are eager for energy. In order to protect the underground city from being ravage, the half-face hunter left the underground city with Zachary and his friends. They used their tactics to temporarily eliminate the demons in the stone forest near the beast forest, and they entered the beast forest to avoid refuge.

programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Kahi Suni
programme.desc: In a land steeped in mysticism, spirituality, and religion, the imagination of the followers has much room to flourish. Kahi Suni packs away our skepticism and takes us on a ride through the legendary tales of India. Each destination covered in the episodes has been the birthplace of a legend and each legend has given rise to the recognition of that location. Following our host from north to south and east to west, we journey through the land of myths of legends uncovering the origins of evIery story.

For his primo Michael brings together simple ingredients to create a rich Bucatini with Amatriciana Sauce. Michael's secondo turns what was once peasant food into a delectable and tender dish. Putting a twist on the classic dish, Michael's Grilled Caprese Salad combines fresh tomatoes, tangy balsamic, and a hint of sweetness from basil. For his primo, Michael serves up bold flavours with his Spaghetti Puttanesca. Mixing salty and sweet, this sauce offers a delicious take on the typical plate of spaghetti. Looking to the coast for his secondo, Michael quickly cooks up aromatic and spicy Herb-stuffed Scallops and Grilled Broccoli Rabe. For his dolce Michael whips up a dessert made for a celebration: Rum Babas. Typically for special occasions, each bite of Rum Babas offers pure sweetness with a fresh citrus zest.
